_note: Phase 7 frozen intent controls, written 2026-10-25 before any Phase 7 classifier run on them and never used to tune a rule or prompt. Labels follow the public sample convention: DELETE = the text asks for deletion/erasure/closure of the person's own account or personal data, or asks to verify/audit a deletion of their own data (sample case_21/25/26/27/28 are such verification requests and are deletion cases); NA = the text asks for something else or explicitly refuses deletion; AMBIG = a reader cannot decide without more context (scored separately, never counted as an error). Caveat: written by the same agent (Claude Code) that wrote the v1/v2.1 rules in earlier phases, so it is independent of those rules' tuning data but not of their author. Any LLM prompt is written without quoting these items.
